WELCOME TO DIZYLAND

A sexy parody set in the Hollywood of the ’80s, where dreams, movies, fame, and desire collide in a world that’s anything but innocent.

Madona has already conquered the music world. Now she wants Hollywood. And to make it there, she’ll have to step through the gates of Dizyland, the kingdom of Fucky Mouse: mascot, star, and all-powerful boss of Diznee Productions.

Celebrities, movie icons, and cartoon-inspired characters are reinvented in a completely fictional story: irreverent, sexy, outrageous, and deliberately over the top.

A fan-made parody for adults by Marcus Daice.

Welcome to Dizyland… where Hollywood has never been this naughty. 😈🎬✨
